description: Prevents endermen from picking up or placing blocks, without touching mobGriefing (Paper plugin for servers, and a Fabric mod for singleplayer or Fabric servers).

mods.name: Enderman Grief Control
mods.description: Prevents endermen from picking up or placing blocks while leaving all other mob behavior vanilla.
